name: FinSMEs
summary: News site about venture capital, private equity and M&A deals, with country feeds and a paid funding dataset.
description: FinSMEs publishes daily funding, private equity and M&A news about startups worldwide, grouped by country (USA, UK, Germany, France, Canada, India, Italy and more). It also sells FinSMEs Intelligence, a subscription dataset of analyst-verified funding rounds, and runs a daily email newsletter; readers are founders, investors, analysts and journalists.
contains: daily funding, private equity and M&A posts
country feeds: USA, UK, Germany, France, Canada, India, Italy
FinSMEs Intelligence: 150+ analyst-verified funding rounds a week on subscription
